name: cronoscope
description: Audit cron schedules against wall-clock reality: dead expressions, silent field shifts, DST skips and duplicates, cross-job collisions.

scripts.verify: npm run licenses && npm test && npm run build:demo && node scripts/verify-demo.mjs
scripts.audit:sample: node bin/cronoscope.js audit examples/jobs.json --from 2026-03-01 --to 2026-03-31 --tz America/New_York --format md --out examples/report-2026-03.md
